title: Run record
description: One JSON line per agent run, appended by the runner (never the agent). Exactly the line agentic-template's scripts/loop.mjs writes to .agent/loop-runs.jsonl; harness fields are optional additions.

exit.description: Process exit code, or the signal name when the process was killed by one.

outcome.description: advanced: the dispatched task left ready/in-progress. stalled: it did not, or another task was claimed. failed: non-zero exit, error result, or no parseable result.

subtype.description: The engine's result subtype (Claude Code: success, error_max_turns, error_max_budget_usd, error_during_execution, error_max_structured_output_retries), or null when no result was parsed. Mapped to attention in state-machines/attention.yaml.

status_after.description: The task's workflow status read back from the task file after the run, or null if the file was gone.

runtime.description: Harness: the runner that wrote the line (claude-loop, ci, stagehand).

permission_denials.description: Harness: count of denied tool calls; non-zero means a question for a human (ADR-0021).

allOf.description: A failed or stalled run carries its reason; an advanced one has none.
advanced means the dispatched task left ready and in-progress (scripts/loop.mjs stall()).
